decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 and LH-02 are both down in Central, with repairs expected 13:30 to 14:30 or later. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 10:00 and has no home place to lose, so lending it costs nothing. It is 0.33 h from C590-09, which holds 256 t at 16.5 g/t (about 136 oz), the best grade on offer, against 9.0 g/t at C564-08. Central trucks (91 t/h) are already near their limit with LH-04 and LH-05 loading (74 t/h). The stockpile has room (303 of 450 t), so one extra LH410 at about 30 t/h only adds value by displacing lower-grade ore. I judged that gain modest, so the 20 oz estimate is rough. I left the development loaders where they are, because taking LH-09 costs 5.7 oz/h and LH-08's 0.4 oz/h would buy little extra at a truck-limited mine. No reserves can be activated, since no stope has been stopped.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
